title: Laszlo Edgar Dobra | Chemical Engineering

about_me: I'm a Chemical Engineering student at UIUC and I'm genuinely obsessed with the world of semiconductors and process automation. I love using Python to model complex systems and finding ways to turn molecular science into high-tech manufacturing. When I'm not working on a project, I'm almost certainly at my espresso machine trying to dial in the perfect shot. I'm just really excited to help build the next major project and solve problems along the way!
